# New device extension proposal

## Use case and purpose

Who needs this extension, and what should it enable?

## Proposed schema

Describe the proposed URI, Device attributes, dependencies, and operation
semantics. Explain overlap with existing specifications or proposals.

## References and compatibility

Link relevant public specifications and discussion. Identify any changes to
RFC-defined behavior that may require an RFC.

## Security considerations

Describe credential handling, authorization, and disclosure implications.
Report vulnerabilities privately as described in SECURITY.md.

## Registration

State the intended registry and link any related PR or expert discussion.
Designated experts review the extension PR before merge. The IANA registration
request follows merge; status remains proposed until registration is confirmed.
